$comment: Known flaky tests that get two retries in CI only (process.env.CI), never locally. Each entry names its file, its full test name (describe blocks and test joined with ' > '), an owner and the evidence. A retried test is listed in its vitest job's summary. Fix the test, then delete its entry. docs/ci.md, 'Flaky tests'.

tests.test: a phone's v1 live view on real Chrome > sends the events and fields the agent-browser engine sent, step for step
tests.reason: Failed 11 times since Oct 26 in browser driver S4 (ubuntu-latest), on the host and in the container; five of the six logged failures are one stall of about 50 s in which navigate through tab-new get no picture. Not reproduced in 72 runs on ubuntu-latest on Oct 29. Each attempt starts its own Chrome.

tests.test: fails only turns whose own steps end in an upstream error
tests.reason: Timed out at 40s twice in one Windows shard run of 839308c052 (136416ms for 7 tests); passes locally in ~1s across 3 runs and on other OSes in the same commit. Disk/SQLite latency under shard load.

tests.test: does not load a step that is no error, or an error step too large to read quickly
tests.reason: Same Windows shard run as above: timed out at 40s, passes locally and on macOS/Linux in the same commit.

tests.test: stops the coordinator's direct turn without cancelling a routine goal waiting on its worker
tests.reason: Failed identically before and after the rebrand (verified on unmodified HEAD): directReplyStarted poll needs a hostTimeout like its siblings; poll default is tight under shard load.

tests.reason: Failed identically before and after the rebrand (verified on unmodified HEAD): the handed turn's FAKE_CLAUDE_DUMP never appears within 20s under load.

tests.reason: Windows shard 7/8 of cbc34a22fe: 'Matcher did not succeed in time' on one poll; 3/3 green locally and green on every other OS shard of the same commit.
